scope: 163 pre-specialty structural nodes across 6 catalog roots
catalogSource: src/hierarchy.js children + getNode; depth-first traversal, deduplicated by node ID
method: Actual CUA tab navigation; DOM title/loading readiness and aria-pressed mode validation; each rendered screenshot visually inspected in contact sheets. Label geometry checked via visible DOM rectangles and screenshots. Route counts are not substituted for visual review.

findings.description: 1280x720 initial viewport can hide bottom controls because header plus minimum workspace height exceeds viewport. Mode click automatically scrolls page to controls, so mode screenshots alone do not close this issue. Root is fixing shared App/CSS.

limits: Default camera plus displayed available modes; not every camera angle or every explode slider value.
Chinese desktop baseline labels all visited; English/narrow final-layout verification pending.
Labels supplement used the last available mode retained per node, normally section/explode; not every mode-label cross product.
Not physical device QA, scientific revalidation, production deployment verification, or all pixel click targets.
Geometry no-regression result belongs to stable 4197 baseline; shared layout final-build gate remains separate.
